name: com.agentfirststack/agentfirststack
title: AgentFirstStack (all services)
description: One MCP server for every AgentFirstStack service: web analytics, tag management with server-side conversion tracking, email inboxes and session replay. Tools are prefixed analytics_, tags_, mail_ and replay_.

authentication.description: API key from one unauthenticated request: POST https://agentfirststack.com/v1/signup (no email). Chat apps can connect with OAuth 2.1 instead (sign in with Google); see auth.md.
